title: Airborne infection control
dek: Smear grade and cough aerosol, not IGRA, decide who is a source. UV, ventilation, respirators, and treatment are engineering plus drugs — genomics does not replace negative pressure.
story: M. tuberculosis is airborne. Infection control is source control (treat, mask the patient), environmental control (air changes, UVGI, outdoor waiting), and personal respiratory protection (fit-tested respirators for staff). A genomics lab that sequences RR-TB but sits unmasked over an open MGIT is performing theatre.

Infectiousness tracks cough and bacillary burden. Smear 3+ cavitary pulmonary disease is the classic source. Smear-negative pulmonary TB can still transmit. Extrapulmonary TB without a draining aerosol is usually not an airborne source — except laryngeal and the pulmonary co-infection you forgot to image.

WHO and CDC isolation-exit rules differ in paperwork; both want clinical improvement plus a microbiologic trend (smear down, on effective therapy). RR-TB isolation is longer in many US protocols. An Xpert RIF-R result is an infection-control trigger the same afternoon, not after the ID conference.
deep: MGIT and LJ are cultured in BSC II; spills are reported. Heat-killed extracts are not live TB but deserve respect until verified.
Household TPT is infection control with a pill. 6Lfx for MDR contacts is that idea with a FQ.
Surgical masks on coughing patients reduce source aerosol; they are not N95s for staff.
CAD/CXR screening in high-risk congregate settings is a find-and-treat IC tool, not a diagnosis of infection.

visual.caption: Three layers of TB IC. Drugs are source control. Air is engineering. Respirators are the last layer, not the first.

example.title: RR Ultra in ED, isolation delayed for “ID consult”
example.setup: Coughing adult, Ultra MTB+/RIF-R at 14:00, still in an open bay at 18:00.

steps.title: RR is an IC result
steps.body: Airborne isolation now; do not wait for a second-line committee.

steps.title: Start effective therapy
steps.body: Source control is BPaLM-class treatment, not a surgical mask alone.

steps.title: List exposed staff/patients
steps.body: TPT decisions later; the delay is the exposure.

example.takeaway: Molecular RR is an infection-control stat, not a seminar topic.

check.prompt: A positive IGRA in a nurse decides airborne isolation of that nurse:
choices: No — isolation is about infectious TB disease, not infection memory
check.answer: No — isolation is about infectious TB disease, not infection memory
check.why: IGRA/TST are infection tests. Sources cough bacilli.

whyWrong.Yes if BCG-vaccinated: BCG confounds TST more than IGRA.

check.prompt: All else equal, the higher-priority airborne source is:
choices: A negative Ultra on induced sputum in a well child

check.prompt: On the hierarchy, fit-tested respirators sit in:
choices: Personal layer, after source and environment
check.answer: Personal layer, after source and environment
check.why: PPE is last, not a substitute for treatment and air.
